resources.string: Reads and inserts text only in the selected editable field when you request dictation. Field text is not stored, logged, or sent over the network. Copy mode is optional and works without this service.
Dictate with your usual keyboard. Use the floating button or Quick Settings tile. Download a model before your first dictation.
Copy mode: copy the result and paste it into your app. No accessibility access needed.
Display over other apps is allowed.
Display over other apps is not allowed. You can still use the tile.
Accessibility service is off. Use copy mode or allow the service to insert text.
Vibrations and sounds follow the global Dictus settings.
The microphone records your dictation. Permission is requested when you start dictating. You can decline and change it later in app settings.
To add Companion, open Quick Settings, tap Edit, then drag the Companion tile into your active tiles.

Tap the field below, then start dictation with the floating button or tile. Insertion requires the accessibility service and a compatible app. Otherwise, copy and paste the result. Protected fields may reject insertion.

To insert dictation, Companion reads and writes only the selected editable field when you request it. Field text is not stored, logged, or sent over the network. Android grants the service access to window content and accessibility events. Enable it only if you agree to this access. You can disable it at any time in Android accessibility settings. Copy mode works without this service. Continuing opens Android settings; you must enable Companion there yourself.
Companion keeps your usual keyboard. Continuing opts in to Companion without changing your default keyboard or enabling the Dictus keyboard.
Open Models to download and select a speech model, then return here. You can also do this later from Settings or the Models tab.

Keep your usual keyboard as the default. If needed, use the keyboard picker below to select it yourself. To try another app, open Notes or Messages, tap an editable field, then use the Companion button or tile. If insertion is unavailable, reopen Companion and copy the retained result.

Optional notifications provide Stop and result controls while dictating in another app. If you decline, tap the Companion tile to stop recording and tap it again to reopen the retained result. You can also use the floating button.
To show the Companion button in other apps, allow Dictus to display over them. This permission is optional: you can use the tile without a floating button.
These settings are not available on this device.
Optional: dictate without enabling or selecting the Dictus keyboard. The Get started button below sets up the Dictus keyboard.
